task.description:
WF-03 Steps 0.5+1: Register and diagnose UAT issue UAT-WF05-v3-001.

Business finding (UAT EO-004 FAIL): After the SwiftRoute tenant onboarding completes, Alice Bauer navigates to the BPM platform at http://127.0.0.1:8080 and is redirected to the bpm-default Keycloak login. The platform does not recognise that Alice's company uses the 'swiftroute' Keycloak realm. Alice cannot reach her company workspace.

Requirements OIDC-F-05 and OIDC-F-06 specify exactly this capability and are MUST priority:
- OIDC-F-05: GET /api/tenant-config?host={hostname} backend endpoint returning oidc_authority + client_id for the tenant bound to that hostname
- OIDC-F-06: Frontend reads window.location.hostname on startup, calls GET /api/tenant-config?host={hostname}, uses the returned oidc_authority to initialize OidcManager instead of the static VITE_OIDC_AUTHORITY

Step 0.5 — Register issue ISS-00XX in docs/issues/ (next ID from issue_index.json). Severity BLOCKER. Category: missing implementation of specified requirements.

Step 1 — Diagnose:
1. Read web/src/auth/AuthProvider.tsx — confirm it uses a hardcoded/static OIDC authority (VITE_OIDC_AUTHORITY)
2. Check if GET /api/tenant-config exists in any Zig route file — it does not
3. Read the full OIDC-F-05 and OIDC-F-06 requirement text from docs/BPM_Platform_Frontend_Requirements.md

Conclusion: straightforward missing implementation — both requirements are fully specified, neither has any code. No root cause ambiguity.

Recommended fix:
- Fix B (Backend): implement GET /api/tenant-config?host={hostname} in a new Zig route handler. Query hostname_bindings → tenant → get realm via tenant_schemas or a new oidc config table. Return {oidc_authority, client_id}. Public endpoint (no auth required per OIDC-F-05 spec). Default to bpm-default if no binding found.
- Fix F (Frontend): on OidcManager init, call GET /api/tenant-config?host=window.location.hostname, use returned oidc_authority as the Keycloak authority URL.

Do NOT write implementation code. Register issue + diagnosis only.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause confirmed: OIDC-F-05 and OIDC-F-06 not implemented

result.summary: ISSUE-FIXER WF-03 Steps 0.5+1: Registered ISS-0072 (BLOCKER). Corrected handoff assumption: OIDC-F-05 and OIDC-F-06 are BOTH implemented. Root cause is a logic gap: hostname-based OIDC discovery (OIDC-F-05/06) cannot route tenant admins when all tenants share a single hostname (127.0.0.1). tenant_hostnames UNIQUE constraint prevents 127.0.0.1 binding to multiple tenants. Fix requires a realm hint mechanism: ?realm=<slug> param on GET /api/tenant-config + frontend URLSearchParams check + onboarding result page login link.

issues.description: Tenant admin login fails after onboarding: GET /api/tenant-config?host=127.0.0.1 always returns bpm-default realm; no realm hint mechanism for shared-hostname access.
